decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The erection of a conservatory to rear elevation of first floor office, as shown on drawing numbers, 504.P.01, 504, P.02 Rev. A, 504.P.03 Rev. A, 504.P.04 Rev. A, 504.P.05 Rev. A, and 504.P.06 Rev. A, all received 5 December 2005 and P.07 Revision C received 15th March 2006(Amended plan), would not harm the appearance of the existing building or unduly reduce the existing amenity of neighbouring properties. Therefore the proposed development complies with the relevant London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003 policies; IMP.2.4 Enhancement of Chiswick Town Centre, ENV-B.1.1 New Development, E.1.2 Locations for Business (B1) Use and E.2.1 Environmental Criteria.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 5 - With respect to any condition that requires the prior written approval of the Local Planning Authority, the works thereby approved shall be carried out in accordance with that approval unless subsequently otherwise approved in writing by that Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:30am to 5:30pm on Mondays to Friday and 9:00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 7 - The glazing in the rear elevation shall be obscure glazed to a minimum height of 1.5m and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.
description: Erection of a conservatory to rear elevation of first floor office.
